title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Engineering
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.     Your Location:  
  This position is CHINA BASED . The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Your recruiter will inform you what cities you are able to work from depending on your personal legal working identity and Airbnb internal policies. 
   
  The Community You Will Join:  
 Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.  
 The Core ML team in Assistance Engineering is the team responsible for adopting the Agentic AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional customer service experience. We are responsible for developing the Chat AI assistant, Voice AI Assistant and more! The team is constantly exploring the SOTA Agentic architecture, develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and leverages tools including SFT, Reinforcement learning, Distillation, RAG/Search,  LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb. 
   
  The Difference You Will Make:  
 We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.  
 You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.  
 Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities. 
   
  A Typical Day:   
 
 
 Envision, champion, and support the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems 
 
 
 Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products 
 
 
 Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team across regions( China and the US).  
 
 
   
  Your Expertise:  
 
 PhD/Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience 
  4+ years of ML engineering experience , with ownership responsibility over large-scale software systems.  
 Background in the design and development of AI and ML systems and services, and a deep passion for building efficient and scalable ML-powered products 
 Experience with LLM driven chatbot and Agentic AI products would be a big plus 
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering, product & design organizations 
  Fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential.  
 
   
  Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:  
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.     
   Reasonable Accommodations:  We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

title: VP, Greater China Region (GCR)
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.    Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.   The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.    We are looking for a strong business leader to lead our fast-growing business in the Greater China region, who will be responsible for driving our business strategy and growth, without compromising on innovation or our Company culture. The person will also have the proven ability to inspire and empower their teams to stretch themselves to achieve ever greater goals and to collaborate closely both locally and globally. You will also mentor and lead our business teams to build consultative business relationships and ensure long-term client success.     
  The person is a strategic business leader – with a strong ability to envision, create and execute on highest impact growth opportunities, to shape and influence how the markets think about our industry and company and can foster the most senior, strategic relationships in the respective regions. This person will be motivated by a desire to make advertising work better for brands, publishers, and partners in those markets.     
  They must have a high aptitude for and comfort level with working in complex business and technology environments along with a strong leadership and business acumen.     
  This role can be based in Hong Kong     
   What You'll Do      
 
  Will be the external and internal figurehead for the TTD’s China, Taiwan and Hong Kong business     
  Lead team to develop and land strategic market plans to achieve revenue goals     
  Working with the team to define and lead an effective upstream sales strategy     
  Own and sponsor relationships with senior levels of stakeholders within target accounts and partners     
  Collaborate with other functional leaders to identify growth opportunities, solve business challenges and drive efficiency across the organization     
  Strong cultural leadership across the whole GCR business.  Driver in creating an environment that inspires the Sales organization to perform effectively and efficiently     
  Ensure effective team management through coaching, mentoring and development of the team     
  Contribute in product roadmap build-out discussions based on client needs with senior leadership, product, & engineering     
 
   Who You Are      
 
  15+ years of experience in online advertising. At least 10 years in a team leadership capacity     
  Deep understanding of the advertising landscape and agency ecosystem across GCR, including China export      
  Proven track record of working within GCR region and strong relationships in the regional markets     
  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to speak to C-Level clients and establish client relationships     
  Proven track record of driving and exceeding revenue expectations through a history of sales leadership experience

title: Senior Research Engineer
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Senior Research Engineer to join our   Hong Kong office. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm with an entrepreneurial and innovative culture at the heart of its business. We value quick-witted, creative minds and challenge them to make full use of their capacities.  
 As a Senior Research Engineer, you will be responsible for helping to lead the development of our trading model research framework and using it to conduct research to develop models for trading in production. You'll expand the framework to become global standard way of training, consuming, combining, and transforming any data source in a data-driven systematic way. You will then partner with Quantitative Researchers to build the trading models themselves. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Help to lead the development and global rollout of our research framework for defining and training models through various optimization procedures (supervised learning, backtesting etc.), as well as its integration with our platform for deploying and running those models in production 
 Partner with Quantitative Researchers to conduct research: test hypotheses and tune/develop data-driven systematic trading strategies and alpha signals 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Machine Learning, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or similar 
 5+ years of hands-on experience MLOps, Research Engineering, or ML Research 
 A strong background in mathematics and statistics 
 Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, with experience in libraries like numpy, pytorch, polars, pandas, and ray. 
 Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing end-to-end machine learning pipelines, including data preprocessing, model training, deployment, and monitoring 
 Understanding of and experience with modern software development practices and tools (e.g. Agile, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability) 
 Understanding of cloud platforms (e. g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e. g., Docker, Kubernetes) 
 
  Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Account Development Representative
description:
An Account Development Representative at MongoDB is the starting point for building a serious career in technology sales.  
 This role is the foundation of our sales organization. You will partner closely with Account Executives to identify new opportunities within strategic accounts, helping drive meaningful pipeline and long-term customer growth.   
 From day one, you will learn and apply structured sales frameworks including MEDDIC qualification, account mapping, multi-threading strategies, and value-based discovery. You will develop technical fluency across modern application architectures, cloud infrastructure, and database technologies, gaining real exposure to how complex software solutions are positioned and sold.  ADRs at MongoDB do more than generate meetings. They help shape early deal strategy, apply MEDDIC principles to qualify real business problems, and stay engaged through the scoping phase to maintain strong deal momentum  
 We invest heavily in structured onboarding, ongoing enablement, and consistent 1:1 coaching. Our ADR team is one of the primary talent pipelines into Account Executive and other revenue roles across MongoDB, with clear, performance-based progression paths. 
 Hybrid Model 
 We believe skill development accelerates when teams collaborate in person. This is a hybrid role based in Shanghai, China. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Own outbound prospecting within a defined set of strategic accounts, working closely with your aligned Account Executives and Sales stakeholders. 
 Research organizations to uncover new initiatives and opportunities where MongoDB can add value. 
 Execute thoughtful outbound outreach across phone, email, and social channels to generate qualified pipeline. 
 Lead structured discovery conversations to understand business priorities and technical environments. 
 Apply MEDDIC qualification principles to ensure high-quality opportunities before advancing them. 
 Stay engaged through the early stages of the sales cycle, contributing to strong handoffs and clean deal progression. 
 Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene in Salesforce and sales engagement tools. 
 Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity targets. 
 
 We’re looking for someone with 
 
 Has a track record of setting goals and exceeding them in competitive or performance-driven environments. 
 Communicates clearly and confidently in Mandarin and English (fluent). 
 Takes ownership of outcomes and follows through on commitments. 
 Can manage a high level of outbound activity while maintaining quality and attention to detail. 
 Is coachable and actively applies feedback. 
 Learns technical concepts quickly and is curious about how businesses use technology. 
 Is serious about building a long-term career in technology sales. 
 Is comfortable initiating conversations with senior stakeholders and handling rejection professionally. 
 
 Things We Love 
 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 Formal training or certifications in sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger) or technical disciplines. 
 Prior experience in sales, business development, or other quota-carrying/customer-facing roles. 
 Exposure to databases, cloud infrastructure, open-source technologies, or modern application development. 
 Experience using Salesforce and sales engagement platforms such as Outreach or Sales Navigator. 
 
 Why You Should Apply 
 
 Great earning potential. 
 Welcoming and inclusive workplace  Meet MongoDB’s Employee Affinity Groups!

title: Senior Software Engineer, C++ (Market Data)
description:
Flow Traders Hong Kong is looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer to lead the next-generation architecture of the market data and execution platforms that power our fully systematic trading. We don't treat market data as plumbing - for us it's a source of alpha, where feed handling, order book construction, and a deep understanding of exchange microstructure are themselves a competitive edge. We're looking for a senior individual contributor who has lived this philosophy in a proprietary or systematic trading environment and can squeeze every nanosecond out of the path from wire to strategy. 
 As a senior individual contributor, you'll be working on the Core Platform that underpins quantitative research, pricing, strategy development, and execution across hundreds of venues. You'll work in a tight, iterative loop with quants and technical traders, applying deep expertise in modern C++, OS internals, CPU and memory architecture, lock-free concurrency, and low-latency networking to push our systems toward state-of-the-art performance, robustness, and observability. 
 What you will do: 
 
 Design and implement high‑performance components for market data ingestion, normalization, and distribution, as well as its usage for order execution and strategy infrastructure. 
 Develop tools and frameworks that enable quants and technical traders to build, tune, and deploy data‑driven systematic pricing and trading strategies. 
 Own the full lifecycle of your components in a fast‑paced, iterative environment: deploy, monitor, profile, and optimize your code in production. 
 Work closely with focus group engineers, quants, and technical traders to refine requirements, collect feedback, and iterate on the platform's design and implementation. 
 
 What you need to succeed: 
 
 BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. 
 5+ years of post‑graduation professional C++ software development experience. 
 Experience building low‑latency market data ingestion, order execution, and algorithmic trading systems in the trading/ financial services industry. 
 Strong knowledge in one or more APAC markets.  
 Strong knowledge of algorithms and data structures. 
 Experience in parallel, asynchronous, and multithreaded programming. 
 Demonstrated ability to write clean, reliable, and highly scalable C++ code. 
 Interest in extracting maximum performance from available hardware and software (CPU caches, memory layout, networking, etc.). 
 Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical colleagues. 
 
   
  Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Software Engineer | Post Trade Analytics
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world-class research. We empower exceptional talent in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting-edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by fostering collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk-adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve complex problems.  Jump Trading's Post-Trade Analytics (PTA) Team is the firm's central source of truth for understanding how we trade. We measure, analyze, and optimize every dimension of our trading activity across all global markets. Our team builds the foundational analyses that traders and quantitative researchers rely on daily to make critical decisions. Operating across highly diverse datasets, our core infrastructure collects, organizes, and stores billions of data points every day, powering the analytics behind a wide array of trading strategies.  As a Software Engineer on the PTA team, you will own the critical datasets and pipelines upon which our trading decisions are built, all while developing in-depth technical and financial business expertise. 
  What You'll Do:  
 
 Partner directly with traders and quantitative researchers to turn complex questions into data products that shape how we trade across global markets. 
 Build, operate, and scale the robust datasets and pipelines that power our post-trade analytics and research. 
 Directly influence business priorities, trading strategies, and execution quality through high-impact data engineering. 
 Guarantee trust in the numbers by building robust data validation frameworks, monitoring, alerting, data lineage, and executing rapid incident response. 
 Drive performance by optimizing data processing and workflows for speed, cost, and resilience, while diagnosing and resolving the most complex pipeline and production issues. 
 Develop and optimize the tools, documentation, and foundational infrastructure that empower the broader research and trading teams. 
 Other duties as needed 
 
  Skills You’ll Need:  
 
 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Software Engineer working extensively with large-scale data. 
 Proficiency in Python or C++ (Strong skills in at least one, with a willingness to work across both). 
 Proven expertise in building, operating, and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines, including orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management. 
 Strong command of SQL and the broader data analytics ecosystem, including familiarity with libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. 
 Sharp analytical and problem-solving abilities, paired with a strong curiosity to understand the financial business logic behind the data. 
 Comfort and proficiency working within Linux environments. 
 Reliable and predictable availability

title: Customer Success Manager (Scaled)
description:
As a Customer Success Manager, you are the trusted advisor helping a high volume of customers navigate their journey on MongoDB using proactive, scalable engagement strategies initiated by health signals and journey milestones. You’ll be responsible for maximizing customer lifetime value and success for a diverse portfolio of thousands of expanding MongoDB customers, acting as a strategic connector between your customers and providing the right help at the right time to achieve their unique business goals. You’ll drive healthy adoption, customer retention, revenue realization, and advocacy at scale. You will innovate, navigate ambiguity, and build scalable programs and processes to deliver real, measurable impact where your customers need it most. 
 We are looking for Mandarin speaking candidates who are based in Hong Kong for our hybrid working model. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Customer Advisory 
 
 Lead and scale effective customer onboarding by leveraging product adoption telemetry to monitor early deployment health, proactively identify and mitigate configuration risks, and guide customers through prescriptive best practices, architectures, and operational strategies that establish a strong technical foundation and accelerate time-to-value and achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB 
 Drive ongoing consumption and value realization through a mix of 1:1 and 1:many engagements (e.g., targeted campaigns, webinars, office hours), using data-driven insights to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across a broad customer portfolio and recommending optimal solutions, features, and adoption paths to achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB 
 
 Account & Portfolio Management 
 
 Own elements of the account plan that drive customer maturity and lifetime value, retention, and revenue realization. Proactively manage thousands of customers across various stages of maturity by leveraging 1-to-many methodologies and tools to balance individual customer impact with scalable outcomes that maximize long-term success 
 Track and report progress against key business outcomes, forecast revenue retention and realization to senior leadership for business predictability, and identify new opportunities to expand customer impact, collaborating with presales teams to support growth 
 Maintain meticulous hygiene in internal systems to ensure a single source of truth for customer insights and accurate territory analysis. Leverage AI-driven tools to streamline daily workflows, improve productivity, and optimize customer success outcomes 
 
 Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy 
 
 Amplify the voice of the customer within MongoDB, leveraging customer insights to inform MongoDB’s product roadmap and coordinate across Sales, Product, Services, Support, and Training teams to drive customer health, satisfaction, and value realization 
 Connect customers with the right internal resources, while contributing learnings from customer interactions to strengthen team success and maximize customer value. Contribute to the evolution of scalable programs that enhance efficiency, customer satisfaction, and measurable outcomes 
 
 What You Will Bring 
 
 Relevant Experience: 5 to 7+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Technical Customer Success, Solutions Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services/Implementation, Technical Account Management) for a deeply technical, ideally consumption-based, product 
 Accountability: 3+ years experience being accountable for customer health and revenue realization across a portfolio of accounts. Experience in managing scaled or pooled portfolios utilizing scalable strategies to enhance customer retention is a plus. Familiarity with designing workflows or engagement strategies using AI or automation-driven tools 
 Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills with the ability to influence technical and business outcomes 
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or equ

By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.   The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.   WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 We are seeking a highly strategic, commercially minded, and technically savvy Associate Account Director to oversee a premier portfolio of our most valuable brand-direct accounts. This role is designed for a senior client services professional who thrives on strategic partnership, executional excellence, and solving complex business challenges. The ideal candidate is a trusted advisor who can influence senior stakeholders, drive client success, and identify opportunities to grow long-term partnerships.

 Platform & Industry Expertise: Maintain deep hands-on expertise across platform capabilities and industry best practices, proactively identifying optimization opportunities and providing strategic recommendations to clients. 
 
 2. Commercial Growth & Portfolio Leadership

 Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Business Development, Trading, Measurement, and Product teams to onboard strategic customers, unlock new opportunities, and deliver integrated client solutions. 
 Strategic Account Planning: Develop long-term account strategies that strengthen client partnerships, increase business impact, and position The Trade Desk as a trusted strategic partner.

title: 产品/市场总监
company: 广州汉和生命科学有限公司
description:
职位介绍
 一、岗位职责
1.市场分析与调研：掌握公司大健康原料产品的市场状况，深入分析行业趋势、竞品策略与消费有效需求，为公司产品的市场定位、研发方向及推广策划提供科学决策依据。
2.新品战略规划：根据公司整体战略和市场趋势，制定年度新品开发规划与产品管线路线图，明确新品定位（功能性原料、特医食品原料、营养补充剂原料等），确定目标细分市场和应用场景。
3. 市场调研与机会识别：跟踪大健康行业前沿动态（如益生菌后生元、植物提取物、肽类、膳食纤维等热门赛道），分析竞品新品策略、终端消费趋势、政策法规变化（如卫健委新食品原料审批、卫健委备案等），输出《新品市场调研报告》，识别高潜力新品机会点
4. 新品立项与研发对接：编写《新品立项书》，明确产品规格、技术指标、目标成本、预期毛利等核心参数，协调研发/技术部门进行配方优化、工艺验证和小试中试，推动新品完成必要的法规备案或审批（如新食品原料、保健食品注册等）
5. 新品上市推进：制定新品上市整体计划（Go-to-Market），包括定价策略、包装方案、技术文档（COA/TDS/MSDS）编制，组织内部新品培训（销售、市场、客服等），编制新品推广物料与话术跟进首批客户反馈，推动产品迭代优化。
6. 质量管理体系建设：建立并持续完善公司产品质量管理体系（对标SO22000、FSSC22000、BRCGS等国际标准），制定各类原料的质量标准文件（企业标准/内控标准），明确感官、理化、微生物、重金属等关键指标，推动通过相关质量体系认证及客户审计。
7. 客诉处理与风险管控：主导产品品质客诉的调查处理，输出8D/5Why等根因分析报告及纠正预防措施（CAPA），建立产品不良反应/异常监测机制，及时启动召回预案，定期组织品质风险分析（FMEA），制定预防性改进方案。
8. 法规合规与标准更新：持续跟踪国家卫健委、市场监管总局等部门的法规政策变化，确保产品标签、宣称、检测报告等符合《食品安全法》《广告法》等法规要求，及时更新产品技术文档，确保COA、SDS等文件的有效性和合规性。
9. 团队建设与培养：负责市场部员工队伍的建设与优化，搭建人才梯队；通过系统化培训与科学的绩效考核，培养优秀市场人员，提升下属的工作效果和整体效率。
10. 跨部门协作：与研发、生产、财务、质量管理等部门保持紧密沟通与协调，确保市场需求能及时反馈至产品研发端，保障产品供应与交付的顺畅。
二、岗位要求
1.学历专业：全日制本科及以上学历，制药工程、生物工程等相关专业优先，硕士研究生学历优先。
2.工作经验：年龄在45岁以下，具备10年以上大健康原料、保健品原料、食品原料行业工作经验，同等岗位3年以上工作经验，有B端原料或OEM/ODM市场管理经验者优先。
3.专业技能：精通市场营销策划与品牌管理，具备出色的数据分析能力与严谨的预算管理思维。
4.管理能力：具备卓越的团队管理能力、项目管理能力及跨部门协调沟通能力，能有效激发团队潜能。
5.沟通能力：拥有出色的商务谈判技巧、公众演讲能力及规范的公文写作能力。
6.个人素质：具备宏观战略思维与敏锐的市场洞察力，抗压能力强，具有高度的责任心与职业操守。
7.技术能力：熟练使用Office办公软件，精通ERP系统、CRM系统等数字化、AI智能体营销管理工具。
三、薪酬待遇：月薪15,000-20,000元+年终奖金+五险一金+带薪年假+过节费+年度免费体检+其他福利（定期组织团建活动、生日关怀、婚丧礼金等人性化福利）
四、职业发展路径
1.横向发展：可根据个人专长与公司需求，转向销售总监、运营总监、副总经理等综合管理岗位，拓宽管理边界。
2.纵向晋升：作为公司核心高管储备，表现优异者可晋升为副总经理-总经理。
五、工作地点：广州市黄埔区星汉大道26号。

We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
  About the Role  
 Netskope AI Gateway helps global enterprises securely adopt, scale, and govern Generative AI. We are seeking a  Staff / Sr. Staff Software Engineer  to architect, build, and scale the core systems powering our AI Gateway product and its supporting microservices across SaaS and on-prem/hybrid environments.

This is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role focused on building highly scalable backend systems, with real ownership: the systems assigned to you are yours to design, build, and defend — depth matters more than volume. Crucially, you will act as the gatekeeper:  you must possess the deep software engineering expertise to audit AI-generated code, ensure architectural soundness, and reject code that introduces technical debt or security flaws.

  Push Engineering Excellence:  Drive the technical culture of the Taiwan team through architectural reviews, code reviews, and mentorship. Advocate for best practices in modern, AI-augmented software development, security, and scalable system design. 
  Deep Systems Debugging:  While not primarily an incident support role, you will be the ultimate escalation point for the hardest systemic development roadblocks. Trace complex issues across asynchronous microservice

description: 职位概述： 1.需求与供应计划专员是供应链团队新设立的岗位，负责为国际业务（AA、EMEA、APAC 区域）建立并管理需求计划职能。 2.该岗位将搭建基础的规划流程、预测方法和数据结构，并与销售、市场及供应链团队紧密协作，确保方案切实可行、可规模化落地。 3.鉴于该职能处于快速发展的阶段，本岗位需要一位既能搭建体系又能亲手执行的实干型人才，能够在架构尚不完善的环境中高效开展工作。 4.与此同时，这也是一个难得的机遇 —— 作为创始团队成员，从零参与搭建全新部门。 岗位职责： 1.建立并实施基础需求计划流程、框架及预测模型 2.基于历史数据、市场趋势及业务输入，开发并持续优化需求预测 3.纳入关键需求驱动因素，如促销活动、招投标、新产品导入（NPI）及产品生命周期变更（导入 / 退市、EOL） 4.建立并维护 SKU 主数据及客户数据，支撑可靠的规划与报表 5.分析预测准确率、偏差及差异，定位根本原因并推动改进 6.与销售及市场团队紧密协作，将商业洞察融入预测 7.将业务计划转化为清晰的供应规划与执行需求信号 8.识别供需缺口（如短缺、过剩风险），并通过跨职能协调推动解决 9.持续改进规划流程、工具及数据质量 任职要求： 1.3–5 年快速消费品（FMCG）行业需求计划、供应链或相关岗位经验 2.有食品饮料（F&B）行业经验者优先 3.熟悉 ERP/MRP 系统实操（熟悉 SAP 者优先） 4.具备较强的需求预测能力，能在实际业务场景中熟练运用数据分析与统计方法 5.精通 MS Excel；熟悉 Power BI 或同类工具者加分 6.对供应链流程及库存管理原则有扎实的理解 7.主人翁意识强，能在架构不完善的环境中独立开展工作 8.细致严谨，能同时管理多项优先级与时间节点 9.积极主动、以解决问题为导向，具备流程改进与体系建设意识 10.协作能力强，能跨职能、跨区域高效工作 11.具备英语读写能力，可与新加坡对口同事沟通

title: 【探索者】过程质量工程师(A246636)
description:
职位介绍
 【职责描述】
1.质量信息收集与监控‌：从市场、售后、生产等环节接收质量信息，如客诉、故障、退货数据，并持续监控动态变化。
‌2.数据分析与趋势研判‌：汇总整理信息，分析质量趋势，识别异常指标和重点问题，输出分析报告。
‌3.问题闭环与改进推动‌：将问题传递至源流改善岗或相关部门，跟踪整改立项与进度，组织跨部门协同解决，并验证改进效果。
‌4.质量报告与归档‌：撰写市场质量报告、质量情报汇总，整理归档资料，为管理层决策提供依据。‌‌
5.横展及管理改进: 定期拉通市场、厂内、新车的问题横展，主动结合统计分析，识别共性课题和问题，通过专项推进质量保证能力提升。

【任职要求】
 1. 学历与经验要求
学历背景：本科及以上学历，优先考虑质量管理、工业工程、机械工程、环境工程等相关专业。
工作经验：整车制造行业体系相关工作经验优先（如体系管理、质量问题管理、制造过程审核等）。
 2. 核心专业能力要求
①了解ISO 9001质量管理、IATF 16949主流管理体系标准，了解标准条款的解读与落地逻辑。
②了解整车制造冲、焊、涂、总四大工艺，熟悉各过程的品质特性，能够基于问题快速锁定关联薄弱过程。
③熟悉产品设计、工艺开发的流程，熟悉产品设计与制造过程工艺管理的设计要点及管理风险管控方法。
④有现场制造过程审核、工艺纪律管理、内审、过程质量管理的经验，有过项目/重点指标问题拉动会议的组织经验。
3. 通用与软技能要求：
①熟悉整车产品开发、工艺设计的项目管理要求及过程风险防控措施。
②能与各部门高效对接，推动过程质量管理风险点的改进等工作。
③熟练使用办公软件（Excel、Word、PPT、飞书等）。

title: 酒店公寓资产管理岗（IT方向）

description:
职位介绍
 1.岗位职责
（1）负责PMS酒店管理系统（捷信达）、OA办公系统、门禁系统、线上培训系统、会员小程序、项目信息系统等各类业务系统的日常运维协调，系统故障时对接外部供应商/开发商并跟踪处理进度直至恢复，保障系统平稳正常运行；
（2）负责对接捷信达等第三方系统供应商，收集、梳理业务部门对酒店管理系统、会员小程序、AI工具、网络及智能化设备等的优化需求，汇总整理形成需求清单，推动系统升级与功能落地；
（3）负责运用AI工具自主开发轻量化应用（如小程序、数据看板、自动化报表等），支撑门店运营管理及资产管理场景的数字化需求，辅助运营提效；
（4）负责公司酒店管理系统、公寓管理系统、会员小程序、门禁系统、线上培训系统、AI工具及项目信息系统等各类系统的账号开通、权限分配与权限回收管理，建立并维护系统账号台账；
（5）负责各门店网络设备（路由器/交换机/AP）、机房硬件设备及智能化设施（自助入住机、智能门锁、送物机器人等）的巡检、保养与故障抢修，及时处置网络卡顿、设备宕机等问题，建立并维护网络及智能化设备台账；
（6）制定并推行公司信息安全管理制度（密码策略、数据备份、外接设备管理等），规范账号权限与数据访问管控，定期开展系统漏洞、弱密码、未授权访问等风险排查，发生信息安全事件时立即启动应急预案，控制损失并及时上报；
（7）统筹运营数据、客户数据的归集管理，按要求开展数据汇总与统计核算，定期出具数据报表；依托业务数据开展分析，梳理运营规律并形成分析建议，为经营管理提供数据支撑；
（8）负责公司固定资产及办公设备的全生命周期管理，建立并维护全口径资产台账，组织资产验收入库、盘点清查、调拨处置及报废核销，确保账实相符；建立资产保修台账，跟踪保修期并提前发起维保或更换申请，规避超期自费维修风险；
（9）负责闲置、报废资产的评估、处置及交易流程，含内部调拨、外部转让、报废核销；配合财务部门完成年度资产评估、折旧核算；定期开展资产使用效益分析，梳理闲置低效资产并提出盘活调剂建议；办理内部资产划转、对外资产转让及备案管理；
（10）统筹公司财产险、公众责任险等险种的规划、采购及日常维护，监督投保及时性，配合出险后理赔工作；
（11）负责各在营/筹开门店营业执照、特种行业许可证、卫生许可证、食品经营许可证等经营类证照的新办、变更、年检、续期统筹；负责公司及权属企业的工商登记、变更、注销及国有产权登记；负责公司章程修订与备案；负责房产证、土地证等权属证书的办理、保管、变更及续期；建立并维护证照及工商事务台账，负责工商类CA证书管理；
（12）完成上级领导交办的其他工作任务。

2. 任职资格
（1）大专及以上学历，专业不限，资产管理、信息管理、计算机等相关专业优先；
（2）具备2年以上系统运维、资产管理或信息化管理相关岗位工作经验，有酒店、公寓或连锁行业从业背景者优先；有PMS系统需求对接或第三方服务商协调经验者优先；
（3）熟悉资产全生命周期管理及系统运维流程，具备较强的制度执行与流程管控能力；熟悉酒店PMS系统及各类办公软件操作，具备网络设备维护与故障排查能力，了解信息安全管理基本规范；
（4）具备运用AI工具开发轻量小程序、数据看板等应用的能力者优先；
（5）具备较强的数据统计与分析能力，能从业务数据中发现问题并提出优化建议；
（6）具备良好的沟通协调及组织执行能力，能有效对接内外部相关方；
（7）工作细致严谨，责任心强，具备信息安全意识和抗压能力。

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and even though we've made a lot of headway, we still have work to do — and that’s where you come in! 
 Duolingo’s designers care about creating high-quality  experiences that look and feel fun . From animators to writers, product designers to researchers, Design brings purpose, feeling, and delight to every interaction with our brand, inside the app and out. As a designer, you’ll join a culture of creativity and craft, where we have a high bar for excellence and an endless curiosity about how to bring more unexpected quirk and fun to the pursuit of learning.  
 Join us in our mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. 
 
  About the role...  
 This role is an important part of the Design team, partnering with other designers and cross-functional teammates on features across our mobile apps, website, and communications. From polishing learner flows to supporting campaigns and community moments, you’ll help shape friendly, intuitive experiences that feel distinctly Duolingo. We care deeply about craft, so you’ll grow your skills while contributing to work that’s both user-friendly and fun, sweating the details to get them just right.  
   
  🧠  You will...  
 
 Design and prototype simple, playful learning experiences for the Duolingo app 
 Drive large work streams across your team with independence—you’ll lead!

title: Lakebase Sales Specialist (Greater China Region)
description:

This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.  
 The role will cover strategic enterprise customers within the Greater China region.  
 Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity. 
  The impact you will have  
 
 Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing Lakebase opportunities within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team. 
 Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency. 
 Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences. 
 Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders. 
 Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.

 Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape. 
 Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs. 
 Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization. 
 
  What success looks like in this role  
 This role requires the ability to operate across  two key motions  simultaneously: 
 
  Establish top strategic focus accounts  by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase. 
  Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration  within Databricks' most strategic accounts. 
 
 Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business. 
 Success in this role requires strength in four areas: 
 
  Business ownership  – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.

  Field enablement  – Build and execute enablement plans that empower AEs and SAs to confidently carry the Lakebase conversation even when the specialist is not present.

title: Quantitative Developer

 Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions and automation. We specialise in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies and mathematical models. At Akuna we have a flat structure, where the best idea wins.  Our Founding Partners, including Andrew Killion, first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Shanghai, Sydney, Singapore and London.

 3+ years of experience developing performant, scalable applications in modern C++

 Solid understanding of multi-threaded/multi-core programming paradigms

 Netskope Secure Web Gateway (SWG) governs how global enterprises reach the web and cloud, and Real-time Protection (RTP) policy is how customers define what is allowed, blocked, or inspected. The RTP team builds the backend services and APIs that manage that policy and deliver it to the Netskope platform worldwide.  We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to architect, build, and scale these services. This is a hands-on IC role with genuine ownership: you take services from design through production and are accountable for how they behave.  We work in an AI-augmented engineering culture. AI tools accelerate us, but the engineer is always the author. We want someone who can direct AI toward correct, generic solutions, recognize when it produced something that merely works instead of something that is right, and hold every line of code to the same standard: lean, meaningful, and exactly fit for its purpose.   What You Will Be Doing  
 
  Service Architecture and Implementation.  Design, build, and scale concurrent, robust microservices and APIs in  Golang . 
  AI as a Force Multiplier, You as the Reviewer.  Use AI coding agents daily; specify problems precisely, push for generic reusable solutions, and reject output that adds technical debt or security flaws. 
  Codebase Stewardship.  Keep code lean and purposeful, consolidate common patterns so duplication goes down, and judge PRs on correctness, edge cases, tests, and abstraction level. 
  Distributed Systems Correctness.  Propagate policy configuration reliably to a global dataplane, reasoning about consistency, idempotency, caching, and failure modes. 
  Customer Issue Resolution.  Troubleshoot bugs and issues raised by customers in a timely manner, and turn recurring ones into structural fixes. 
  Partnering Across Teams.  Work with product, UI, dataplane, QA, and platform teams across time zones; raise design concerns early. 
  Raising the Technical Bar.  Shape engineering culture through design, architecture, and code reviews and mentorship. 
  Operating What You Build.  Join the shared on-call rotation and monitor the health of your services. 
 
    Required Skills and Experience  
 
  Background.  8+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years on backend services and distributed systems.

• 有实验室质量管理工作经验者优先。

• 执行力强，能严格按照 SOP 和检测周期完成工作，对结果负责；
• 具备良好的沟通协调能力，能在多环节协作中主动推进问题解决；
• 有责任心、细致严谨，具备长期在实验室技术方向深耕的意愿。

1、创新技术加持：参与全球首款芯片化、智能化、床旁(POCT)呼气分子分析微型气相色谱仪在疾病无创早筛和健康管理的探索，契合医学检验未来AI化、智能化的发展方向。

2、设备和仪器管理经验：提供 GC-MS 与微型气相色谱仪的方法学开发与仪器管理实战机会，助你成长为平台核心技术骨干。

title: Risk Manager
description:
Flow Traders is looking for an experienced Risk Manager to join our Risk team in Hong Kong. The ideal candidate is communicative, decisive, and thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. 
 The Risk Manager will report into the regional Head of Risk and work alongside a small team responsible for Market & Credit Risk (MCR) and Treasury & Capital Management (TCM) across our APAC trading business. This is a hands-on role that combines quantitative risk analysis in close collaboration with Trading and Technology. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Evaluate and monitor APAC trading positions against market and credit risk limits, across multiple asset classes including Digital Assets 
 Provide management with regular updates on P&L and risk exposure 
 Analyse trading strategies and perform quantitative and qualitative risk analysis 
 Support the Head of Risk in developing and enhancing the risk management framework, policies, and procedures for the region, working in coordination with global Risk teams 
 Develop, implement, and enhance risk models, quantitative analytics, reports, and processes, using automation and AI tools 
 Ensure other risk categories, including credit, operational, and regulatory risk, are managed within the business's risk appetite 
 Support daily Treasury, securities borrowing and lending (SBL), and capital management activities 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 3-5 years of relevant risk management experience within a trading environment 
 Degree in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Computing, or a related quantitative field 
 Strong financial markets, products, and valuation knowledge across multiple asset classes. Knowledge of Digital Assets is preferred. 
 Comfortable making decisive, well-reasoned calls on OTC risk requests under time pressure 
 Proficient in SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in applying AI tools to improve the efficiency of risk processes 
 Adaptable to a multi-prime broker environment and APAC-specific market structures 
 Strong communicator and team player, able to work directly with Traders, Technology, and external stakeholders 
 Meticulous and detail-oriented, with strong numerical and logical reasoning abilities 
 
  Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Open Source Networking Software Engineer - ToR Switch / SmartNIC / DPU
location: Home Based - Americas; Home Based - APAC; Office Based - Beijing, China; Office Based - Taipei, Taiwan
description:
Software has moved to play a central role in network technology. From outstanding routing implementations like Bird and FRR to overlay networking technology such as OVN/OVS and Cilium, from kernel with SwitchDev to userspace with DPDK, from P4 to OpenFlow, the relationship between network innovation and software continues to deepen. We are building teams to bring the very best open source networking software to market in a well integrated and opinionated stack that brings the latest hyperscaler innovation to end users and enterprise customers. 
 We work with networking silicon providers to optimize Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data center networking, from bare metal through virtualization, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically. 
 You will have a good chance of success if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking, with a special interest in the interface of hardware ASICs for acceleration and software for innovation and control. We value experience in open switch initiatives such as SoNIC and DENT, and upstream experience with components such as routing, kernel networking, eBPF, DNS, firewalls and load balancers. Our selection process is rigorous and requires work from the candidate as six to eight interviews over a period of months. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation, security and performance in your work. 
 At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, Private Clouds, MAAS and Kubernetes across a broad range of devices and use cases. 
  Location : we have network software engineering roles in APAC (Top-of-Rack switches) and Americas (SmartNIC/DPU) time zones. 
 What your day will look like 
 
 Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available

title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality and Test Engineering
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform,  Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives  such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. 
 The company is founder led, profitable and growing. 
 We are hiring an  Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality Engineering , to lead the team responsible for the test suites which validate hardware compatibility with Ubuntu Linux (Core, Desktop and Server – see  https://ubuntu.com/certified  for more information). We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices. 
 As the Engineering Manager of the Certification Quality team you’ll lead a dedicated testing team, shaping the vision and setting the pace, in collaboration with the rest of the Certification and hardware enablement teams. You will lead the certification test strategy for Canonical’s PC OEM and ODM partnerships, including Advantech, ASUS, Dell, HP,  and Lenovo, deepening the test coverage for both new and existing certified hardware. You will pioneer the use of Canonical’s open source test frameworks and custom designed hardware to drive automated hardware validation of the operating system. This is a challenging position for a quality focused engineering leader, and requires an analytical mind with a passion for test automation and team leadership. 
  Location:  This role will be office based in Taipei Minsheng district, Taiwan. 
 This role entails 
 
 Lead the development and maintenance of Canonical’s hardware certification test suite 
 Manage timely delivery of certifications as part of the hardware certification programmes 
 Work collaboratively to ensure continuous improvement of test practices and tools 
 Build and lead a globally distributed team of engineers 
 Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development 
 Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders 
 Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation

 Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners 
 International travel twice per year for company events up to two weeks long

 A good understanding of Linux system architecture
